Interface ScoringPolicy

All Known Implementing Classes:
ScoringPolicy.CardScoresPoints, ScoringPolicy.CompositeScoringPolicy, ScoringPolicy.LastTwoTricksScorePoints, ScoringPolicy.RankScoresPoints, ScoringPolicy.SuitScoresPoints, ScoringPolicy.TricksScorePoints
public interface ScoringPolicy
A distinct scoring element within a trick-taking contract.

Each element encapsulates one point-giving concept, likw a suit, a specific card, a rank, or tricks themselves.

Lead restrictions are handled separately by LeadRestriction. Composite scoring is supported via ScoringPolicy.CompositeScoringPolicy.
